name: AuthGate
shortDescription: Authentication and authorization dashboard with MFA, lockout and security headers.
features: PBKDF2-SHA256 (200k) hashing + per-user salts; generic login errors (no username enumeration)
Failed-attempt lockout + per-IP/per-user fixed-window rate limiting
Security headers: CSP (default-src 'none'), frame deny, nosniff, no-referrer, no-store; HSTS flag documented
Server-side sessions with expiry + logout invalidation
knownLimitations: Demo scale: in-memory rate limiter resets on restart; single-process only
MFA secret shown on enable (demo convenience; production would show once via QR)
